Invoice basics

Everything a new business owner should know before creating an invoice

What is a GST invoice maker?

A GST invoice maker helps create invoices with tax details, business information, customer information, item rows, totals and payment terms.

Who needs GST invoices?

GST-registered businesses, agencies, contractors, shops, consultants and service providers may need GST invoices depending on their transactions.

What should a GST invoice include?

Common fields include invoice number, issue date, supplier details, customer details, GSTIN, item descriptions, tax rates, totals and terms.

When should you check with a CA?

For exact compliance, place of supply, tax split and filing rules, confirm with your accountant or tax advisor.

Practical tips

Invoice details that help clients pay faster

Add your GSTIN and customer GSTIN for B2B invoices when required.
Use clear product or service descriptions and HSN/SAC details where applicable.
Check whether the transaction needs CGST/SGST or IGST with your accountant.
Keep invoice numbers consistent through the financial year.
Mention payment terms and due date to reduce follow-up confusion.
